text:
alex_cs: Quick request — DeltaHealth has a partner walkthrough 09:00 SGT tomorrow and hit throttles earlier. Need temporary APAC egress allowlist + burst (~500 QPS) for 4 hours. Must forward X-Delta-Session header. Who can own?

mira_netops: Post CIDRs and exact UTC window please. Edge-level allowlist + header passthrough?

alex_cs: CIDRs: 203.0.113.250/32,198.51.100.5/32. Window: 2026-08-03 01:00 -> 05:00 UTC (09:00 -> 13:00 SGT). Edge allowlist + header passthrough. Project: delta-prod. Renewal note: they mentioned stability as a blocker.

sam_eng: I can create ephemeral policy. Plan: qps steady=60, burst=500, auto-expire at 05:00 UTC, tag=pilot-delta. Canary to apac-edge-1 for 10m and alert to #eng-sre if 429>0.5%.

billing-bot: tag pilot-delta added for billing export.

sam_eng: CLI snippet:

```
redwoodctl policies create \
  --name delta-apac-pilot-2026-08-03 \
  --project delta-prod \
  --region apac \
  --cidrs 203.0.113.250/32,198.51.100.5/32 \
  --header-forward X-Delta-Session \
  --qps 60 --burst 500 \
  --expires 2026-08-03T05:00:00Z \
  --tags pilot-delta,billing,auto-revoke
```

mira_netops: Firewall + proxy passthrough configured on apac-proxy-01. Please run smoke curl to validate header.

alex_cs: smoke returned 200 OK, header preserved, no 429s in first 7m.

sam_eng: Applying to canary now, will monitor and then roll.

sam_eng: policy created in apac-edge-1 (canary) and rolled to apac-edge-2 after 15m. Grafana panel + alert wired. Auto-revoke scheduled.

sam_eng: policy auto-revoked at 2026-08-03T05:00:03Z.

alex_cs: Demo success reported; logging pilot results + customer feedback in account_health sheet. We'll propose steady-state uplift in renewal with cost estimates. Thanks everyone! :tada:
